title: Collect X saved-search results after access and cost validation
description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a editor, I want an X saved-search Monitor when permitted access is available, so that relevant posts can enter the same discovery pipeline.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Collect X saved-search results after access and cost validation
  Scenario: Configure a saved search
    Given X API access, usage terms and costs have been validated and separately authorized
    When an X Monitor collects its configured saved-search results within allowed limits
    Then results retain post identity, source link, query/Monitor provenance and observation time
    And repeat observations follow the common deduplication and update rules
  Scenario: Access or budget is unresolved
    Given required X access or spending authority is missing
    When collection is requested
    Then the Monitor reports the unresolved prerequisite
    And it does not purchase access or promise a price
```

Saved searches may be implemented through a validated query/API mapping; do not assume a specific X endpoint exists. Ryan’s roughly $20 discussion is interest only, not purchase authorization or a confirmed price.
